working_title: An iid FPP law with proved KPZ exponent relation
ranking_quote: 5,P0110,An iid FPP law with proved KPZ exponent relation,attempted_un,iid FPP law with proved KPZ relation
exact_statement: Find an iid undirected nearest-neighbor first-passage-percolation passage-time distribution on Z^d, d>=2, for which fluctuation and wandering exponents are defined and chi=2xi-1 is proved. The survey itself phrases Question 22 as: Find a distribution of passage times where (4.19) holds.
primary_source: https://sites.math.duke.edu/~rtd/FPP/50yrsFPP.pdf, Section 4.3, equation (4.19), Question 22, PDF pp. 87-88; lines 5230-5258 in web extraction
source_quote: Question 22. Find a distribution of passage times where (4.19) holds.
conditional_theorem: https://annals.math.princeton.edu/wp-content/uploads/annals-v177-n2-p07-p.pdf, Theorem 1.1: iid weights on Z^d (d>=2), nearly gamma law and finite MGF near zero; upper exponential moment bounds A1,A2 and lower variance/wandering bounds A3,A4 define chi_a,xi_a,chi_b,xi_b. If chi_a=chi_b and xi_a=xi_b, then chi=2xi-1. https://arxiv.org/pdf/1109.0523, Theorem 2.2: Auffinger-Damron prove the same conditional equality without nearly-gamma, assuming mass at the support infimum is less than p_c(d). Their printed (2.2) lower bounds take an infimum over every nonzero displacement, whereas Chatterjee A3-A4 allow exclusion of a finite ball. This distinction matters for bounded-away-from-zero laws.
small_displacement_caveat: For any iid law supported on [a,b] with 0<a<=b<3a, the direct edge is uniquely minimizing between adjacent vertices, so D(0,e_1)=0. Thus the literally printed Auffinger-Damron (2.2) xi_b condition cannot hold for Uniform[1,2], although this does not refute Chatterjee's asymptotic A4 definition or the P0110 target.
hardest_missing_bridge: For one nondegenerate iid undirected law, prove matching upper and lower fluctuation and wandering exponent bounds in the strong senses A1-A4; Chatterjee's relation is conditional on their matching.
